name: Zapier
summary: An online service that connects apps and automates repetitive tasks without code.
description: Zapier is an online automation service that moves data between apps without programming. You build 'Zaps': when something happens in one app (a trigger), Zapier does something in another (an action), such as saving email attachments to cloud storage or adding form responses to a spreadsheet. It offers integrations for more than 9,000 apps. A free plan covers simple two-step automations with a monthly task limit; paid plans add multi-step automations and higher limits.

pricing.free_tier_details: Free plan: 100 tasks per month, unlimited two-step Zaps (as listed on the official pricing page).
pricing.paid_plan_summary: Professional and Team plans add multi-step Zaps and higher task tiers; Enterprise is quote-based. Yearly billing is offered at a discount.
pricing.costs_beyond_price: The apps you connect may have their own plans and limits.

key_capabilities.text: Moves data between apps without being a developer, with integrations for more than 9,000 apps.
Free plan includes Zaps, Tables and Forms, and lists an AI assistant (Zapier Copilot).

limitations.text: Free plan is limited to 100 tasks per month and two-step Zaps.
Costs grow with task volume; estimate how many tasks your automation will use each month before relying on it.

best_for: Non-technical people automating work between popular online apps
Small teams that want automations running without managing servers
not_ideal_for: High-volume automations on a zero budget
Organisations that must keep all data on their own servers
getting_started: Write down the repetitive task as 'When X happens in app A, do Y in app B'.
Create a free account and build a two-step Zap for it.
Test the Zap with real data and check the result in app B.
